title: identity.principal.revoked v1 data
description: A principal's credentials were revoked. AUDIT RECORD, 365-day retention, and the counterpart to identity.principal.issued.v1. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2.

principalId.description: The principal whose credentials were revoked.

reason.description: Why revocation happened. `compromised` is the one a security consumer must treat as an incident trigger.

revokedBy.description: Principal id of whoever or whatever performed the revocation. An automated rotation names the component.

effectiveAt.description: RFC3339 time the revocation takes effect; may be earlier than the envelope `time` when a revocation is recorded after the fact.
